label: Thin and act readings of perfection of being on one subsistent source: controls
paraphrase: Closed finite profiles; statements about them only. A source that is its own being and a living effect; two stipulated pure determinations, one standing for being and one, a Boolean stand-in for life (not any recorded sense of LIVING). Thin profile: only being is a perfection of being and the source has only being; d164b1ff holds, c4fb87a6 fails at the stand-in for life, and the source lacks it. Act profile: every pure determination is a perfection of being and the source has every determination; both premises and their composite hold. On the thin profile, with the effect as the only recipient of esse, R-act₁ (the esse of whatever is not its own being is received in a principle and limited), own being is no recipient (7338142d) and a nonrecipient's determinations are pure (32695660) hold, while R-act₂ (intensive esse) with the thin reading fails; with the intensive reading taken as purity it holds. Locus (b): on the thin profile with the intensive reading taken as purity, R-act₂, purity and own being hold, yet the source does not really have the stand-in for life and d164b1ff read intensively fails; and the source lacks no perfection of being in the mode-open act of a frame where everything is in act (9a0a4951) while still not really having it. It witnesses where a thin reading of 'perfection of being' (PERFECTION_OF_BEING_1) leaves the pair: it can keep d164b1ff and must give up c4fb87a6; and that reception of esse does not by itself give intensive esse. It is not evidence for either reading.
